Container.Name: Daybook
Container.Overview: Daybook syncs one practitioner's Jane/iCloud calendar every day, tracks every client session, and makes sure notes are confirmed. The desk view (/kiosk) shows today's plan with two large confirmations per session (no-show / done + notes), a cleanup list for sessions unconfirmed within 3 days, and clients not seen in over two months to discharge or follow up. Also tracks billable hours and exports CSV. LAN-only by design; reach the desk device over WireGuard or Tailscale. No email or cloud service is required. This template pulls the image published by GitHub Actions.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Daybook web UI and desk/kiosk view

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Set this. Controls 'today', the 5pm reminder and displayed times.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container
